subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 3 – Lesson 2: Team Talk – Finding the sports centre
outcomes: I can understand the places Reem and Julia talk about.
I can use Right!, No way! and Hey, look! in the right situation.
I can talk about places I have been to.

tf.s: Reem and Julia are looking for the sports centre.
tf.why: Yes, they are trying to find the sports centre.

tf.s: Sharifa lives in the apartment building.
tf.why: They pass the apartment building where Sharifa lives.

tf.s: Julia went to hospital because she fell off her bike.
tf.why: She was sick after eating too much chocolate at the factory.

tf.s: “I went to the stadium” is in the present simple.
tf.why: Went is the past simple of go.

tf.s: The girls are going to be late for their swimming class.
tf.why: Yes, they don’t want to be late for swimming.

tf.s: Julia liked hospital because the Wi-Fi was very good.
tf.why: She was bored and the Wi-Fi wasn’t good.

tf.s: At the end, the sports centre is right behind them.
tf.why: Hey, look! It was there all the time.

tf.s: We say “No way!” when we are surprised.
We say “Hey, look!” when we want someone to stop looking.
tf.why: Hey, look! asks someone to see something.

tf.s: The girls visited a chocolate factory in the past.
tf.why: They remember the day when they went to the chocolate factory.

boxes.why: It’s the apartment building where Sharifa lives.

boxes.q: What class are the girls going to?
boxes.why: They are going to their swimming class.

boxes.q: Why did Julia go to hospital?
boxes.why: She was sick after too much chocolate.
They find it right behind them.
No way! shows surprise at bad news.

boxes.q: Respond: “This is where we saw our friend Halima.”
boxes.why: Right! shows you agree or remember.

boxes.q: Complete: That’s the stadium ___ my brother went to the football match.
Why couldn’t Julia go online in hospital?
boxes.why: The Wi-Fi was bad, so she was bored.

boxes.q: Complete: I ___ to the harbour last week.
boxes.why: Last week is the past: went.

hunt.q: The girls are looking for the…
Julia’s brother saw a match at the…
Want a friend to see? Say…

mcq.q: Which places do the girls talk about?
mcq.why: These are the places in the dialogue.

o: She was bored and couldn’t go online.
She had to stay there for a year.
mcq.why: The Wi-Fi wasn’t good, so she was bored.

mcq.q: Where did Julia eat too much chocolate?

mcq.why: No way! means I can’t believe it!

mcq.q: “Are we near the harbour yet?” – “___ I can see the sea!”
mcq.why: Hey, look! points to something you can see.

mcq.q: A: There’s a skyscraper in our town now. B: ___
mcq.why: B is surprised by the news.

mcq.q: Choose the correct sentence about a place you have been to.
o: I went to the harbour. I saw big boats.
I go to the harbour yesterday.
I going to the harbour last week.
mcq.why: Use the past simple: went, saw.

mcq.q: Why is it funny that the sports centre is right behind them?
o: They were looking for it, but it was close all the time.
mcq.why: They walked around looking for a place that was next to them.

mcq.q: Which is the fib? Three are facts about the dialogue.
o: Julia’s brother played football at the stadium.
Sharifa lives in the apartment building.
The girls have a swimming class.
mcq.why: Julia’s brother went to a football match; he didn’t play.

mcq.q: In “the apartment building where Sharifa lives”, what does “where Sharifa lives” do?
o: It gives more information about the building.
mcq.why: Where joins extra information about a place.
